family_directives.objective: Investigate only the verified BPR and full-observed-listwise capabilities. Declare every active typed parameter, adapt values from prior confidence intervals and execution-conformance diagnostics, and do not claim an implementation distinction that is absent from the capability contract.
family_directives.temporal_history: Investigate the verified strictly past temporal-history capability. Adapt only its declared active decay, shrinkage, residual-scale, and training-row parameters; do not vary inactive capacity or optimizer knobs.
